title: Mentor Construct Tutorials and Challenge Gates
description:
Purpose: Contextual tutorial prompts, holographic trainer appearances, and short gated challenges in Training Arena and hub. Skippable and replayable.

Behaviour:
- Spawns trainer_ai_hologram_npc at tutorial_hologram_projectors when entering training nodes; displays ring-projected tips (no copyrighted oath lines).
- Tracks tutorial completion flags in CSavedProfile; exposes toggle in hud_wrist_menu Settings to enable/disable guidance.
- Challenge gates: simple tasks (e.g., fire bolt, raise shield, place platform) that validate input timing and provide feedback. On success, grant small mastery and unlock basics.

Components read/write:
- Reads player state and construct events; writes CTutorialState flags; uses dialogue-like prompts but implemented as IMechanic overlay prompts.

Acceptance hooks:
- Tutorials present during Training Arena; can be skipped and replayed.

Assets/scenes: training_arena, central_battery_plaza; assets: trainer_ai_hologram_npc, tutorial_hologram_projectors, ring_ui_hud_assets.
